def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize whitespace/case variants in text columns
    for col in ['species', 'island', 'sex']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype('object')
            mask = df[col].notna()
            df.loc[mask, col] = df.loc[mask, col].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    # fix sign errors in flipper_length_mm (negative values within valid magnitude)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # drop rows with body_mass_g outside the valid range [2500, 6500]
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    g = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: round(float(v), 2) for k, v in g.items()}
